The first time I ever walked into a gym, I squatted 315 at a weight of about 165.

I literally put up almost double bodyweight on my first try because I had spent the last 5 years training horse stance very diligently.

r/BWF is full of threads asking how to get better leg training than their recommended 3x8 step ups, and at one point they pretty much begged me to spill the beans but I won't tell them because they are communists and I hope they die horribly.

You people on Voat however get the inside scoop on how to train horse stance exactly as it was taught to me.

Before anyone spergs at me over martial arts stuff, keep in mind that these poses/kicks are for training and conditioning and not actual use in a fist fight, at least in my opinion.

The flow of the workout:

  • Horse stance (goal of 45 minutes)

  • Lunge stance (goal of 45 minutes each side)

  • Front kicks (goal of 250 per leg)

  • Side kicks (goal of 250 per leg)

I was originally advised to do the workout every other day. I did not maintain the full intensity above for very long, but I did achieve it.

Horse stance: http://i.imgur.com/G6ApHDp.jpg

  • Feet double shoulder width apart

  • Bend knees until thighs are parallel

  • Try to keep ankles, hips and shoulders on a vertical line. This is not a squat isometric. Sticking your butt out is an error. See pic: http://i.imgur.com/ciYZjAF.jpg

  • !!! IMPORTANT !!! Try to squeeze the ground with your feet.

  • This is an isometric move. Hold it for time, like a plank.

Lunge or "bow" stance: http://i.imgur.com/kVEY1p0.jpg

  • Also double shoulder width

  • Hips and shoulders both squared forward and aligned

  • Front thigh to parallel

  • Front knee over front toe (confirm against a wall, pillar etc)

  • Back leg out 30-45 degrees backwards from body. NOT directly behind in a straight line.

  • Point rear foot forward as much as possible. ~45 degrees is acceptable. This should be a calf stretch.

  • Again, squeeze ground between your feet.

  • Hold for time.

Front kick:

  • Stand with your feet together

  • Bring leg up to the chamber position: http://i.imgur.com/oCSkWqw.jpg

  • Bend supporting leg slightly. Kick out. Point toes backwards so the impact is with the heel.

  • Bring leg back to chamber position, rapidly

  • Lower foot to the ground

  • Do each repetition explosively

Side kick: http://i.imgur.com/H3ogiDv.jpg

  • Just as before, start by bringing foot off the ground to the chamber position

  • Bend supporting leg slightly. Kick out sideways. Hip height or a little above is fine. Foot should be parallel to the ground or with the toe pointed slightly down. Toes should be pointed up so the impact is with the heel. Hips, shoulders and kicking leg should all be aligned on the same vertical plane. http://i.imgur.com/AqcxyEt.jpg http://i.imgur.com/nYYxCM8.jpg

  • Just as before, retract quickly to the chamber position again.

  • Just as before, do these explosively.

Once again, 45 minutes horse stance, 45 minutes of each lunge stance, 250 front kicks each leg, 250 side kicks each leg, repeat every other day.

This is exactly as I learned it, simple in theory but insane in execution.
